reason: The RA01 preregistration labels its total-balance expression as the P2E20 representation-floor policy, while P2E20 formally uses an integrated 1.6e-15 cm baseline and also scales the compartment tolerance. This adjudication corrects authority interpretation only; the running RA01 execution is not changed.

frozen_domain_equivalence.conclusion: For every frozen B01/B14 RA01 route, F_repr/dt dominates both baseline terms. Therefore the executed RA01 total-balance tolerance is numerically identical to the P2E20 total representation-floor tolerance on this domain.

scope_interpretation.valid_claim: RA01 prospectively transfers the P2E20 total representation-bound discriminator to the frozen root-active domain while intentionally retaining the stricter C6R compartment/head/iteration controls.
scope_interpretation.invalid_claim: RA01 is not a full transfer or root-active validation of the complete P2E20 numerical policy, because the P2E20 compartment integrated allowance is not transferred.
scope_interpretation.qualification_if_green: A green RA01 qualifies this conservative hybrid research-only Reference authority on the frozen B01/B14 root-active matrix.
scope_interpretation.qualification_if_red: A red RA01 leaves ROM-ROOT blocked; no policy component may be loosened from observed RA01 failures.
